test_policy.notes: Test-optional for spring, summer and fall 2027 applicants: a high school GPA of 3.4 or better is automatically admitted; below 3.4 goes to review and may be asked for an essay and letter of recommendation. ACT 21 / SAT 1060 or better is recommended for scholarship consideration. The international requirements page lists no SAT/ACT requirement and a minimum 2.5 GPA.

requirements.notes: International application with a $35 processing fee. Academic records need a cumulative GPA of at least 2.5 as calculated by the Office of International Admissions; unofficial copies are accepted for admission, official ones before check-in. A non-refundable $500 deposit is required before an I-20 or DS-2019 is issued, with bank statements showing funds for one year.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, applicants outside the U.S. (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International page: fall Apr 1 (outside the U.S.) and Jul 15 (inside the U.S.); later applications are considered for the next session. Printed without a year, treated as 2027. Domestic priority date for fall is also Jul 15.

deadlines.label: Global Freshman Scholars priority deadline 1
deadlines.notes: Must be fully admitted by this date, then apply through JagSPOT. The award is competitive and limited.

deadlines.label: Global Freshman Scholars priority deadline 2
deadlines.notes: Second priority date (fully admitted by then).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of, or those who completed secondary education in, listed English-exempt countries (including Australia, Canada, Ireland, Jamaica, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa, the UK and the US) need no proof. Also accepted: iTEP 3.6 and a grade of A, B or C on UK Advanced-level English exams. No intensive English pathway or conditional admission for freshmen is described on the page.

cost.notes: International estimate used for I-20 issuance: tuition and fees $20,486 (12 credit hours per fall and spring semester), housing and food $9,330, books $1,000, health insurance $3,439 (other), total $34,255. Per-credit-hour undergraduate tuition is $386 in-state and $772 out-of-state for Arts and Sciences, higher in Computing and Allied Health ($802 out-of-state), Business ($822), Engineering ($832) and Nursing ($870); the tuition page's title says 2025-2026 but the rate tables are headed 2026-2027.

aid.notes: Global Freshman Scholars Talent and Ability Scholarship (from fall 2026): competitive, for degree-seeking international freshmen on F-1/H-4/L-2 with a 3.0+ high school GPA; the award is in-state tuition rates, renewable up to four years with a 3.0 GPA each year; no dollar figure is listed. Endowed awards (Carter GlobalUSA, Pitsios, Constantine) need 3.0-3.5 GPAs; apply through JagSPOT. The CDS H6 section on aid to nonresidents is not reliably legible.

sat.note: The admissions pages say to send scores to South Alabama but do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: The admissions pages do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is listed on the pages checked; look it up in the ETS code search.

tier_notes.general: Admits about 71% (IPEDS) to 94% (CDS) of applicants with an SAT middle 50% around 1010-1200 (CDS); slightly above a plain D because it is a large research-oriented public with engineering, computing and nursing programs.
